line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

decision: R1197/1200 retain selected package directory binding. Current product provider stages the system directory inside MAX_PATH, so with this particular destination its oversize alternative is redundant; dropping only that expression would remove zero mirror points and zero diff lines. The zero-length path does require early return. R1198 preserves OEM-to-ANSI conversion between the OEM expander and ANSI open callers. R1199/1201 retain the selected strings across the LIM and DOS readers and release each old selection when the original linked-extension parser accepts a replacement.
